name: Slumbering Walker

abilities.text: At the beginning of your end step, you may remove a counter from ~. When you do, return target creature card with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

covers.line: ~ enters with two -1/-1 counters on it.

notes: Removing a counter is a negative counters effect on the source; the card only ever has -1/-1 counters, so that is the counter removed. 'When you do' is the reflexive trigger (CR 603.12), which fires only when the optional removal really happened.

issues: you may remove a counter from this creature — expected remove a counter of ANY kind — if a +1/+1, stun, or other counter has been placed on it, you may remove that one instead — scripted counters op hardcoded to counter:'-1/-1', amount:-1. The script's note ('the card only ever has -1/-1 counters') is false in general — any counter-placing effect breaks it — CR CR 122.1 / 701.x — 'a counter' with no kind specified means a counter of any kind

you may remove a counter ... When you do, return target creature card — expected declining leaves the counters alone and the reflexive trigger does not fire — scripted structure is correct (may + reflexive gated on lastHappened, CR 603.12), but the blind scenario 'Declining to remove a counter returns nothing' failed — counters 1 !== 2, Grizzly Bears reached the battlefield, i.e. the decline was not honored. Likely the harness AI answering the 'may' rather than a script defect

you may remove a counter from this creature — expected remove A COUNTER of any kind; if the creature has no counters, the action is impossible, the removal doesn't happen, and the reflexive trigger does not fire — scripted counters target:'self', counter:'-1/-1', amount:-1, hardcoded to -1/-1. addCounters (game.ts:290-296) clamps total<=0 by deleting the entry but still emits, so with zero counters the 'removal' registers as a change, lastHappened becomes true, and the reflexive return fires anyway — free recursion every end step once the counters are gone. Also cannot remove a +1/+1 counter another effect placed — CR 121.3, 603.12

Blind scenario 'Declining to remove a counter returns nothing' failed — expected decline -> counters stay at 2, P/T 2/5, Grizzly Bears stays in graveyard — scripted engine 'may' handling (game.ts:1576-1579) is correct; the scenario script has no {"answer": false} step before {"resolve": true}, so the default agent accepted. This failure is a scenario-authoring gap, not proof of a may/reflexive bug — but it means the decline path is untested — CR 603.12
